description: Validates task input schema and path safety before any task leaves PENDING. Called twice per execution (submit + run_task) — intentional. Mirrors engine/guardrails/validation.py.
instructions: validate_task_submission() is the sole guardrail entry point. Custom guardrails are added here, not in capability code.
Called once in submit() (early rejection) and once in run_task() (resolves capability reference). This duplication is intentional.
Enforce path traversal protection: reject any path with ../ that escapes workdir.
Validate that the capability key exists in the registry before proceeding.
Return the resolved Capability object in run_task() path.
Guardrails run before policies PENDING transitions. They are additive, not a replacement for capability-level input validation.
